name: Untitled
tagline: The most themeless theme ever themed. Grayscale, derived rather than chosen.

contrast_exempt.muted: the darkest band the derivation produced
contrast_exempt.dark_foreground: 4.49 is where the even-band spacing landed, not a choice
contrast_exempt.blue: same band as dark_foreground; hue is gone, only the order survives

notes: Palette is computed by ranking the eight ANSI hues by Rec.709 luma.
